grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are authorised to cancel this Marriage Allowance claim

grants.description: Access your Marriage Allowance claim status and history from HMRC records
grants.purpose: To verify you have an active claim and determine your authority to cancel

grants.description: Provide the reason for cancelling Marriage Allowance
grants.purpose: To determine the effective date of cancellation and tax implications

grants.description: Acknowledge understanding of tax implications of cancellation
grants.purpose: To ensure you understand the tax consequences, including potential underpayment

grants.description: Authorise HMRC to modify your tax code and your partner's tax code
grants.purpose: To remove the 'M' or 'N' suffix from your tax codes and restore normal Personal Allowances

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Marriage Allowance enquiries on 0300 200 3300 before cancellation is processed
revocation.effect: Cancellation will be stopped. Marriage Allowance will continue until you cancel again or it is ended by circumstance change.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot cancel Marriage Allowance without your explicit final confirmation of the cancellation reason and acknowledgement of tax implications. Agent cannot cancel on behalf of your partner unless you confirm the relationship has ended. Agent cannot contact your partner about the cancellation.
